mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) predicts higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as rising corporate demand boosts equity valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during GDPC1 growth periods, or GDPC1 growth reverses before returns materialize.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in UNRATE below 3.5% in a month signals labor market tightening, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive despite UNRATE crossing threshold, or returns persist negative beyond 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: Combined low FEDFUNDS rates (<2%) and rising GDPC1 (demand) create an easing monetary cycle, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 2.0% and GDPC1 growth > 5% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when both proxies are active, or FEDFUNDS rise above 2% during the period.

mechanism_narrative: A >2% drop in INDPRO (supply) from peak during a late-cycle expansion predicts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as supply constraints boost valuations.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls >2% from peak in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive despite INDPRO decline, or returns persist negative in contraction periods.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST exceeding 1300 units triggers positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as robust production signals strong consumer demand.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive despite HOUST crossing threshold, or returns turn negative within the period.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high PAYEMS (>150k) and falling UNRATE (<3.5%) indicate a tight labor market, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 150263 and UNRATE < 3.5% in the prior month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when both proxies are active, or returns persist negative despite the combination.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS dropping below 2.5% during a monetary tightening cycle predicts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as policy signals a shift to easing.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive despite FEDFUNDS falling below 2.5%, or returns remain negative in non-tightening periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO (supply) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as expanding production boosts market confidence.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive during INDPRO growth periods, or returns persist negative despite sustained supply growth.
